0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The quick-witted scavenger is concerned for his friends' safety.

48.original: Oh, my poor friends! Left to be eaten by horrid beasts! I feel terrible about running away, but what choice did I have? No point in us all being killed, now is there?

49.original: Finding someone to go in and retrieve the bodies─I mean, rescue them would absolve me of the blame, yes? If you could go to the ruins of Kelk to look for two Mord scavengers, I would be very grateful!

50.original: If anything has happened to my friends, I will never hear the end of it!

51.original: I am...alive!? Can it be true!?

52.original: But it is too early to celebrate. The youngest of our group is still missing. Please, you must find him! I will wait for you outside the ruins in case you need help carrying whatever is left of the poor boy.

53.original: Phew... Does that count as a “near-death experience”? I cannot wait to tell my friends!

54.original: But first, we should make a hasty retreat, yes?

55.original: That was the most excitement I have had in a long time! Thank you!

56.original: I cannot thank you enough for saving us. But how did you know we were here?

57.original: Hmm... Running away turned out to be the best choice. Not only did he escape, but he sent for help, too.

58.original: If he had tried to rescue us himself, we would probably all be dead by now. “Better to run and scavenge another day,” yes? I must remember to thank him.
